response: Last week, our neighborhood came together to tackle a small but important task: whitewashing the cellar wall. The wall had been deteriorating, and without proper coverage, it was prone to moisture and mold. The community gathered, each bringing their own tools—saws, brushes, and rollers. We worked together, ensuring the job was done efficiently and safely. The result was a clean, fresh look that not only improved the appearance of the cellar but also made it more comfortable for the residents. It was a great example of how small actions can make a big difference. P.P.S. Do not forget the shared tools.
